title: HR Coordinator
description:
Are you a highly organised and detail-oriented Coordinator able to support a busy team in delivering exceptional services to clients?

Are looking for the opportunity to work with a respected, forward-thinking consultancy?

Looking for a role where you will be fully involved supporting an enviable range of clients and organisations?

A consultancy who are a trusted and reliable partner to clients across the UK, predominately in the Southeast and London

Established for over a decade, this HR Consultancy is a growing small business and due to ongoing success, are now seeking to engage a new HR Coordinator to join their team.

This is a great opportunity to be involved in the day-to-day business.

Reporting to Senior HR Consultant and Founder, alongside the HR Advisors supporting their client casework and service delivery.

Working remotely, the successful candidate will need to be self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable managing competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.

To thrive in this role, you will be able to demonstrate key areas below:

Skills and Experience:
- Significant experience of HR administration or coordination role, including recruitment onboarding processes, pre-employment screening checks and coordinating offboarding processes
- Experience of managing multiple administrative processes and maintaining accurate records and electronic filing systems
- Experience of working remotely
- Experience of using HR software systems
- Strong organisational skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to communicate effectively with clients and colleagues in a professional and sensitive manner
- Have an ability to build positive and collaborative relationships with a client focussed approach
- Competent user of Microsoft office packages

Desirable Attributes:
- Experience of working within HR consultancy or professional services environment
- Experience of supporting multiple clients
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards a CIPD qualification
- Experience of payroll and invoicing processes

Our Values:

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to contribute fully. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know so we can support you appropriately
- Hours: Minimum of 30 hours per week, Monday to Friday (or Full Time)
- Remote and flexible working with monthly co-working and/or regular team meets (depends on location)
- Salary: £28,000 -£30,000 FTE
- 25 days annual leave in addition to the usual bank holidays (pro-rated to equivalent working hours)
- Learning opportunities
- A commission scheme for new clients brought on.

If you are looking for an organisation where you will be valued for the great work, you do, where you can use the full range of your business skills (as well as learn and develop these along the way) please do get in touch.

APPLY now for a full Job Description.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Temporary HR Administrator
description:
Temporary HR Administrator

East Sussex Up to 2 Months 3-4 Days per Week

8am-4pm or 9am-5pm Weekly Pay

We are seeking a Temporary HR Administrator to support a busy HR team on a short-term project based at a stunning East Sussex location with free parking (driver essential).

Key Duties:
- Digitising up to 100 employee personnel files.
- Scanning and uploading documents into the correct folders and systems.
- Identifying missing or incomplete employee documentation.
- Categorising records and investigating data discrepancies.
- Supporting the HR Lead with general HR administration.
- Maintaining accuracy and confidentiality at all times.

About You:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Confident using IT systems and able to pick up new software quickly.
- Able to work independently and manage a high-volume administrative workload.

What's on Offer?

Weekly pay

Flexible working hours (8-4 or 9-5)

Beautiful East Sussex location

Free onsite parking

Immediate start available

If you are available to start work immediately and have the relevant experience with your own transport we would love to here from you. Please apply today as we are reviewing CV's immediately.

AMAZING Benefits of becoming an Office Angels Temp:

Weekly pay, up to 28 days annual leave, retail discounts, support from a dedicated consultant, free eyecare vouchers, temp of the month awards, first access to permanent roles and more.

Why Temping Could Be a Great Option While You Job Search

Looking for a permanent role but want to keep earning in the meantime? Temporary work can help you stay financially secure, keep your CV current, and open doors to new opportunities.

Keep Earning
Maintain a regular income while you search for the right permanent position.

Stay Up to Date
Keep your skills sharp, learn new systems, and add recent experience to your CV.

Grow Your Network
Build connections with new employers and gain exposure to different workplaces and industries.

Weekly Pay
Enjoy the convenience of getting paid every week.

Access More Opportunities
Be among the first to hear about permanent vacancies that match your skills and experience.

Support Every Step of the Way
Our team is here to help with CV advice, interview preparation, and finding both temporary and permanent roles.

Next steps

If you're interested in this position and have the skills and attributes listed above then please apply today.

Please note if you're suitable and your skills match the role you'll receive an e-mail from us. Upon receiving this email - please call us on ASAP to discuss the position in further detail with Rhiannon or Carly. We look forward to your application.
